name: Windows and apps
description: Switch to an app (or open it), minimize, maximize, close or quit it, show the desktop, and show which app is in front. Windows, macOS and Linux (X11, Sway, Hyprland).
author: PerritoDeck contributors

actions.name: Switch to an app
actions.description: Brings the app's window to the front, or opens the app if it isn't running. Press again to go through its other windows.

fields.label: App name or part of a window title

actions.name: Minimize, maximize or close a window
actions.description: Acts on the window in front, or on an app's window if you name one.

fields.label: App or window title (empty: the window in front)

actions.name: Quit an app
actions.description: Asks the app to close all its windows, as if you clicked their X buttons, so it can still ask to save.

actions.name: Show the desktop
actions.description: Moves every window out of the way. On Windows and X11 a second press brings them back.
